pkgmetadata.longdescription: MinerU is a high-quality document parsing tool that converts complex documents (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, and images) into LLM-ready Markdown and JSON. It supports multiple backends including VLM-based inference and ONNX pipeline for layout detection and OCR.

use.flag: Enable ONNX pipeline backend with layout detection and OCR support
Enable AWS S3 storage support via boto3
Enable VLM (Vision Language Model) backend via torch and transformers
